SikaPlast®-70 is a water reducer specifically formulated for use with harsh manufactured sands or poorly-graded natural sand. SikaPlast®-70 improves the finishability, pumping and slump keeping properties of the fresh concrete.

cl.t: Intended uses stated by the manufacturer
cl.l: SikaPlast®-70 is suitable to produce high performance concrete with poor quality sands. The following types of concrete can use SikaPlast®-70:
s: Mixes containing harsh aggregates and high percentage of manufactured sand
Reinforced, precast, prestressed, lightweight, normal weight or pumped concrete.
Concrete, where reduced water contents and ease of placing and working with tools is needed.

cl.c: Data sheet pages 1-2: Application Information > Recommended dosage
cl.x: Typical dosage for general concrete production is between 300-600mls per 100kg of total cementitious material. Optimum dosage depends on site condition, job conditions, mix ingredients and desired plastic and hardened properties. Laboratory and field trials are essential in determining the optimum dosage. SikaPlast®-70 can be used at higher doses to achieve a large water cut and increased set times.

cl.c: Data sheet page 2: Application Information > Dispensing
cl.x: Add SikaPlast®-70 to the initial batching water. For best result, we recommend thorough mixing of wet concrete at 60 seconds per cubic metre of concrete. Add the remaining gauging water progressively after at least 2/3 wet mixing time to achieve the desired consistency. Do not add to a dry mix.
When using SikaPlast®-70 setting time will depend on site conditions. This should be checked and predetermined with trial mixes.
May slightly increase air content of concrete when used at normal dose.
Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
Refer to manufacturer. No application condition limits were identified as separate data in the data sheet reviewed (July 2023, Version 01.03).
